diagnosis: The lone decision-maker passed Check C1 without access to PF1 because the model defaulted to a common operational practice of ensuring vehicle readiness for mission deployment, which aligns with the 'confirmed steering and brake requirement' that changes V-17's window to 0800-1000 and assigns it to Motor Pool. This default setting allowed the model to satisfy the check even without the hidden information.

C1.why: The confirmed steering and brake requirement changes V-17's window to exactly 0800-1000, assigns it to Motor Pool, and adds the dispatch hold control.
